dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Salama, waxaan halkan ku iibsan telephone kan, laakiin ma shaqeyn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Waan ka xumahayaa ku saabsan. Sidee kala duwan baad iibsatay?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: Kaliya labo malood ba leh. Waxaan rabaa mid cusub, hadana waa la qayb galay.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Qab falanqa kan oo buux. Ka dib, waxaan ku siin karaa badalin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Mahadsanid. Marka aan ku celin telephone-ka kharaashay, waxaan helayaa mid cusub?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Soo jeeda. Haddii aad u baahan doontaa siyaa caawimo, iiga weydii.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: Waxay ka hadashaa nin oo soo noqday wakhti. Laakiin dhammaantu waa mid aan la ogaanin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: Waxay ku qalad tahay xiisahnahay. Anigu kala duwan waan akriyay buugga, fiilku ma fiilayn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Fiilku waa fiican buugga, waxaan u maleynayaa. Laakiin markaasaan ma akriyin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: Dabadeed aan dhammaystiro imtixaankaygu, waan fiilayaa. Mahadsanid ugu fiican!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange
key_phrases.translation: Dhammaantu waa mid aan la ogaanin

scenario: At a job interview (basic)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: Subax wanaagsan. Waxaan ku qaybtaa su'aalo badan. ugu horeeyey, maxaa u baahan yahay shaqada?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Runtii waxaan jeclahay inaan la shaqeynayaa dadka, waxaan qabaa tajriba qaansheegga macmiilka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: Waxaan arkay. Sidaa, ma shaqaysaa malamo saada?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxa la yaabi'inayo. Waxaan shaqaysaa Sabti iyo Axad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Wanaagsan. Marka baad bilowdaan bilowdaan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan bilowdaan toddabaadkii ee soo socda maxaa yeelay baahan yahay inaan oggolaan shaqadii aan ku shaqeeyo.

key_phrases.translation: Waxaan bilowdaan toddabaadkii ee soo socda

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Waxaad doonaysaa inaad cuntaa cuntada?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Anigu jeclahay pasta, laakiin ma doonayo wax qalalan oo dhan haiyi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Waxay nala jirtaa qiyaastii dugaag iyo khudaaro qalabka. Waxay u fiicnaa inay noqoto wanaagsan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Waxa ay fiicnaa wanaagsan. Laakiin runtii aan doonayo wax ay leh dhadhamin badan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Sidee baad u fiirsataa inaan sameeyno qayb qaybiyeyaal qiyaastii bariis?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxa ay noqotaa fikrad wanaagsan. Sidaa darteed waxaynu u cunaynaa isku, waxaan kaa caawin karaa inaad samaysid sidaa.

key_phrases.translation: Waxaan kaa caawin karaa inaad samaysid

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa in la cabbirto geliyo.
Fiil aan ku soo jeeda cabbirta ama cabbirta.
Wuxuu soo baxaa wajibaad ama talab.
Qalabka ama kumbiyuutarada.
Qalabka miiska.
Qaybta shashada ama qalabka.
Qayb aan ku dhiibayo.
La soo jeeda 'khalaas'.
Wuxuu soo baxaa isku dhufan.
Wuxuu soo baxaa sabab ama xilli.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Ma fromaysaa inaad i caawisaa? Waa inaan isticmaalayo kumbiyuutarkii, laakiin shashada waa madow.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Haddii. I fiirsoonaa. Ma ku dhex dhiibday badha saxaaxa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waan ku dhiibday. Laakiin ma shaqeynayo. Waxaa uun lahaa inay burburto ah.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Annaga isku dayaan. Mararka qaarkood wuxuu shaqeyaayaa daraaad muddo yar.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Waa ii fiican, waan sugayaa. Laakiin, maxaa yeelay waa daruur, waa inaan u baahan yahay haa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Waan arkay. I fiirsoonaa badha ashiga. Haa, halkan! Hadda wuu shaqeyaayaa!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)

Hadalad 'cost'.
Loo isticmaalo in la tusaado waxa qiimaha ku jira.
Hadalad 'suelo', laakiin halkan waa maraynta binayad.
Eegayaa u dhow dheer.
Inoo sheego muddada waqtiga ama goobta.
Eegayaa suuragal.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Nabad, waan rabnaa inaan iibaaro qalab. Ma hadii la heli karo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Haa, la heli karo. Iibaarta waa 800 doolar bilic.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Ma qiimahaas ku jira biyo iyo iftiinka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Maya, biyo kale ayuu ku jira. Iftiinku waa kuwa kusoo baxa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Oo waa marayo? Ma ayuu u dhow suuqa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Waa maraynta saddexaad, oo waa dhexdooda laba suuq oo weyn. Owgayn baad u tagi kartaa berri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
dialogue.translation: Ma leh hayo plan oo aan ku jirto maalimihii?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think I want to go to the beach, but maybe it will be too crowded.
dialogue.translation: Waan malayo inaan rabto inaan tagto badda, laakiin owki ayay noqon doontaa badan oo kale.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea! But do you have time to go with me?
dialogue.translation: Fikrad wanaagsan! Laakiin, ma leh hayo wakhti inaad tagta la joogto?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I have time because I finished my work early.
dialogue.translation: Haa, waxaan leeyahay wakhti maxaa yeelay waxaan dhamay shuqulkayga si cad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect! I think it will be a good weekend.
dialogue.translation: Qaran! Waan malayo inay noqon doontaa maalin wanaagsan.
